goal: Commercial-capable monetizable automatic gym video editor. Track provenance of weights and underlying training datasets separately.

production_weights.dataset_terms_summary: ImageNet dataset access is restricted to noncommercial research and education. Applicability of dataset access terms to separately distributed pretrained weights requires independent assessment.

research_only.dataset_terms_summary: Academic purpose only; pretrained checkpoint commercial rights not established.

future_data_sources.publisher_warning: Google does not warrant the license status of each original photo; verify rights individually.
future_data_sources.usage_rule: Only use individually verified images with retained attribution/source/license and explicit commercial allowances.
future_data_sources.models: Future original trained detector, not a shortcut to inherit rights from third-party checkpoints.

future_data_sources.source: Original or synthetically generated gym images
future_data_sources.usage_rule: Document photographer/creator consent, branding/identifiable persons permissions where relevant, and owned commercial redistribution/training rights before use.

release_policy: A model code license alone does not establish rights to the source dataset or inherited weights. Do not automatically declare commercially cleared without separate review.
